prompt: gettext LC_MESSAGES mingw arbitrary value substitute
answer:
On MinGW systems that do not define `LC_MESSAGES`, GNU gettext defines it as:

```c
#define LC_MESSAGES 1729
```

The value is intentionally arbitrary; `1729` is described as the smallest positive integer representable in two different ways as the sum of two cubes. GNU gettext uses this value to simulate the `LC_MESSAGES` category, storing its locale name separately when the system lacks that category. ([libintl.h](https://chromium.googlesource.com/external/msysgit/msysgit/+/chromium-1.9.0/mingw/include/libintl.h), [gettext manual](https://www.gnu.org.cach3.com/software/gettext/manual/html_node/Locating-Catalogs.html))
